what: Bulk check: clusterlifter (E0081, mode sphere, friction off) against the unmodified engine at the 2D shallow conditions where baselines exist.

conditions.note: Every quantity fails. The clusterlifter engine gives 36% higher horizontal energy and 8% lower thickness. This is a condition where the unmodified engine has slow episodes starting at cycle 285; the clusterlifter has none, suggesting the contact handling changes the dynamics.

summary: At the two depth-5 conditions and at depth-10 with f*=0.5 the clusterlifter agrees with the unmodified engine. At depth-10 with f*=0.3 it does not: every quantity fails, with horizontal energy 36% higher. This is a condition with significant lasting contacts even in the unmodified engine.
